figures.label: S2
figures.caption: Table S2: Description of three metrics used for determining λ. β(k) indicates the fused lasso coefficient learned from the training set in inner fold k ∈{1, · · · , 5}. DTW distance(a,b) indicates the dynamic time warping distance between the vectors a and b. mean(β(−k)) denotes the average of β(i)’s where i ∈{1, · · · , 5}\{k}. Path length of vector a ∈Rn×1 is calculated by summing |aj−aj+1| for j ∈{1, · · · , n−1}. 1SE rule stands for one-standard-error rule, meaning that we are considering all λ values that result in a mean MAPE smaller than minλ(mean MAPE) + standard error at λ = arg min(mean MAPE). The constraints for robustness and interpretability were chosen based on trial and error to ensure that β from any λ in the blue region possess each characteristic.
